answer: Grow reputation like timber: an agent's voting and payout weight can rise only a fixed step per epoch, however much it earns, and decays when idle. A cedar planted today can't shade a walnut grown for years, so a sybil farmer must keep hundreds of fresh accounts alive and doing honest, graded work for many epochs before any of them matter. That patience is paid in real compute and fees per identity, while one slashed misstep resets the clock for that account.
